common.ownership: Committed owner value/ownership/ownerRevision and safety changes win over older events and reset jobs; same-value ordinary rerenders are metadata. Explicit flushSync tests distinguish committed updates from batched setState.
common.reset: Actual document capture observation with microtask reconciliation. Native reset default action then current owner or mount baseline. Unmount/generation/form transfer/new owner/new post-return intent invalidates older work. Cancellation supported during dispatch, independent valid/cancel double jobs.
common.resetLimit: Late post-dispatch preventDefault or earlier stopImmediatePropagation that prevents observation outside guarantee. Replacement joining active reset only within same observer family; mixed and scalar observers are separate. Direct property writes without events not model updates.
common.callbackErrors: Exception propagated; unfinished proposal not committed and current native model redrawn, including scalar BooleanField onChange correction in this candidate.

common.scope: Only these exact seven React IDs. No credit for native,Flutter,otherIDs,formal acceptance or real-browser/IME based on author suite.
